fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced legacy urban plant. Main vehicle entrance off S Kedzie Ave (~41.7602,-87.7030) crosses the perimeter fence; satellite z21 shows split in/out lanes with directional arrows; Street View shows a guard booth in the entry lot.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white guard-booth structure visible in Street View (2024-07 / 2025-06 panos) standing in the entry parking lot just inside the Kedzie gate.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Tight urban site - the gate sits directly on S Kedzie Ave with limited internal stacking before the yard splits to docks/parking.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate opens directly onto S Kedzie Ave, a busy 4-lane urban arterial; a truck queue at the gate would spill onto the public road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple dock banks - south building face along the rail line and east-side docks; total well over 50 doors. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large dedicated trailer drop yard on the SW of the property, full of trailers parked in dense rows (z18/z19 imagery); 100+ trailers visible, capacity ~200.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (rail-side south docks vs east-side truck docks) - shipping/receiving physically separated.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur tracks run directly along the south building face off the adjacent Belt Railway corridor; the plant is rail-served (z19 imagery at 41.7576,-87.7055).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left low-confidence.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Single gate stage observed; no clear second checkpoint - left false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Plant is a connected multi-section complex; counted as effectively 2 main masses but it is one continuous facility.
